page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a bare-metal instance type configured with 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 512 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4 GB of RAM per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources without virtualization overhead.

This instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. It does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps, facilitating high-speed data transfer between the instance and external storage or other network resources.

Given the integration of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and 128 dedicated physical cores, this server represents a high-density hardware profile. The qualitative cost efficiency is optimized for workloads that can fully parallelize tasks across multiple GPUs and high-core-count CPUs, mitigating the overhead of multi-node clustering. The instance is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads, including deep learning inference, medium-scale AI training, high-performance computing, video transcoding, and 3D rendering pipelines.
